# Phase 4: Implementation Plan

1. Confirm requirements and architecture have passed their approval gates.
2. Break work into dependency-ordered tasks with requirement traceability and completion evidence.
3. Include tests, API documentation generation/sync verification, code review, and release preparation where relevant.
4. Use [the implementation plan template](../../templates/impl-plan-template.md) for `impl-plan.md`.
5. List unresolved prerequisites and wait at the plan approval gate.

The phase agent is `.github/agents/sdlc-step-04-impl-plan.agent.md`.
